The walk line and two buttons render in a third .bk-foot-bar under the gate using existing classes (no CSS file touched). The head's 'first step from L0' was not built (sheet/Head.tsx outside write set); next_table from L0 covers the agent side. README (coupled doc) and ADR 0187 added.
